entry.title: Welcome to mysite
entry.content:
Welcome to your new HAX site! Click edit on the top bar to get started

What can I do?

We've got a ton of blocks that are easy to use and get a lot done with little effort, so much in fact we made a little video exploring some of them!

Here's a list of just a few things to get started, or if your a pro, delete this content and have fun!

  1. Edit this content by hitting "Edit page" above
  2. Hit enter in a paragraph of text to add another one
  3. Click "Merlin" to see a list of all the things you can do
  4. Try to add a video, or edit this one
  5. Insert a video

This looks fun, let's go!

Get involved with HAX

We hope you enjoy working with HAX as much as the team has enjoyed building it! If you want to join our community, hit "Merlin" and look for the Discord link among other ways to get involved!

  • Read our HAX Teaching excellence resources
  • Join the HAX community
  • Post an issue in our issue queue

entry.title: Hasil Cek Config Server Drupal
entry.content:
Ringkasan Infrastruktur

Hasil pemeriksaan konfigurasi server Drupal dan mapping situs web.pesanweb.my.id / belajarweb.pesanweb.my.id.

1. Server home.pesanweb.my.id (192.168.2.40)

  • Docker stack drupal811: nginx (drupal_web_server, publish 8086:80 dan 8087:81), d11_fpm (Drupal 11, PHP 8.4), d8_fpm (Drupal 8, PHP 7.4), drupal_database (MariaDB), phpmyadmin, mysql-cron-backup harian ke /data/compose/34/db-backup/
  • DB: drupal8, belajarweb, web, drupaldb, appdb

2. Server belajarweb (192.168.2.57, hostname armbian-master)

  • Nginx Proxy Manager (npm_app) meneruskan belajarweb.pesanweb.my.id ke http://192.168.2.57:8087
  • Stack drupal-nfs: nginx, drupal_fpm7 (Drupal 8), drupal_fpm, phpmyadmin, mysql-cron-backup, drupal_db (MariaDB)
  • DB di sini: belajarweb, drupal8, drupal11, drupal8db
  • Multi-site aktif hanya: sites/belajarweb.pesanweb.my.id (DB belajarweb, user belajarweb) dan sites/default (DB drupal8)
  • Folder sites/web.pesanweb.my.id TIDAK ADA di server ini

3. Kesimpulan

web.pesanweb.my.id dilayani oleh home.pesanweb.my.id:8087 (DB drupal8 di sana), sedangkan belajarweb.pesanweb.my.id dilayani oleh server terpisah 192.168.2.57:8087. Untuk menyalin konten web ke belajarweb perlu dump dari DB drupal8 di home.pesanweb.my.id lalu import ke DB belajarweb di 192.168.2.57.

entry.title: Hasil Cek Config Server 192.168.2.57 (belajarweb)
entry.content:
Ringkasan

Hasil cek langsung ke mesin 192.168.2.57 (hostname armbian-master) via SSH hop dari home.pesanweb.my.id. Konfirmasi: belajarweb.pesanweb.my.id live di 192.168.2.57, bukan di home.pesanweb.my.id. Sumber kebenaran routing ada di tabel proxy_host Nginx Proxy Manager (NPM) yang berjalan di mesin ini.

1. Routing NPM (otoritatif)

Query langsung ke DB NPM (npm_db, database npm, tabel proxy_host):

iddomainforwardenabled
1belajarweb.pesanweb.my.idhttp://192.168.2.57:8087ya
2tty.drupal.lokalhttp://192.168.2.52:2222ya
3curhatmu.my.idhttp://192.168.2.52:81ya

web.pesanweb.my.id TIDAK ada di NPM ini — domain itu disajikan oleh nginx di home.pesanweb.my.id (port 8087 host → vhost :81 container → Drupal 8). Dua situs dengan nama mirip, dua mesin berbeda.

2. Docker stack drupal-nfs di 192.168.2.57

Container (swarm service)ImageFungsi
drupal-nfs_drupal_nginx.1.*nginx:1.29-alpineWeb server, 2 vhost (lihat §3)
drupal-nfs_drupal_fpm7.1/2.*drupal:8.9.20-php7.4-fpm-alpine3.13PHP-FPM Drupal 8 (2 replica)
drupal-nfs_drupal_fpm.1/2/3.*drupal:11.2.2-php8.4-fpm-alpine3.21PHP-FPM Drupal 11 (3 replica)
drupal-nfs_drupal_db.1.*mariadb:latestDB server, volume drupal-nfs_drupal_db_data
drupal-nfs_phpmyadmin.1.*linuxserver/phpmyadmin:5.2.2phpMyAdmin
drupal-nfs_mysql-cron-backup.1.*fradelg/mysql-cron-backupAuto-backup DB harian (healthy, jalan 2 minggu)
npm_app.1.* / npm_db.1.*jc21/nginx-proxy-manager / mariadb-ariaReverse proxy + DB konfigurasinya

Compose project root: /data/compose/98/ (isi: drupal8-src, drupal11-src, drupal8_files, drupal8_data, nginx-conf, db-backup, dump, import, images, snippets, template, private).

3. vhost nginx di mesin ini (/data/compose/98/nginx-conf/drupal.conf)

listenserver_namerootfastcgi_pass
80drupal11.lokal/var/www/html/drupal11/webdrupal_fpm:9000 (D11)
81_ (default)/var/www/html2/drupal8/webdrupal_fpm7:9000 (D8)

Komentar di file conf sendiri menulis: port 81 container di-map ke 8087 di host — itulah port yang dituju NPM. Situs D8 pakai multisite: Host header belajarweb.pesanweb.my.id → folder sites/belajarweb.pesanweb.my.id/.

4. Database (MariaDB drupal-nfs_drupal_db.1.*)

DatabaseJumlah tabelKeterangan
belajarweb244Pakai belajarweb.pesanweb.my.id (user belajarweb, host drupal_db)
drupal8244Fallback sites/default
drupal1174Situs Drupal 11 (vhost :80)
drupal8db22Tidak dipakai multisite aktif

5. Multi-site & settings.php

  • sites/belajarweb.pesanweb.my.id/ — satu-satunya situs aktif, DB belajarweb
  • sites/default/ — fallback multisite; DB drupal8 (file settings-nya masih menyisakan placeholder contoh databasename di bagian komentar — hati-hati saat baca)
  • Tidak ada folder sites/web.pesanweb.my.id/ di mesin ini — membuktikan web.pesanweb.my.id bukan situs mesin ini

6. Verifikasi HTTP dari home.pesanweb.my.id

  • curl -H 'Host: belajarweb.pesanweb.my.id' http://192.168.2.57:8087 → HTTP 200, title "Selamat datang | Belajar Membuat Website" (tema skilling: 33 lesson, 12 exercise, 12 project, 1 quiz)
  • Host lain (misal web.pesanweb.my.id) juga dapat 200 karena mengenai vhost default (server_name _) — tapi di produksi NPM tidak pernah mengarahkan domain itu ke sini

7. Rencana ekspor DB web → belajarweb (antar mesin)

  1. Backup DB belajarweb di 192.168.2.57 dulu (wajib — import menimpa total)
  2. Dump DB drupal8 (punya web.pesanweb.my.id) dari container drupal_database di home.pesanweb.my.id
  3. Pindahkan file dump ke 192.168.2.57 (scp via hop) lalu import ke DB belajarweb di container drupal-nfs_drupal_db.*
  4. Sync files/: dari sites/web.pesanweb.my.id/files/ (home) ke sites/belajarweb.pesanweb.my.id/files/ (192.168.2.57)
  5. Rebuild cache: drush cr di drupal-nfs_drupal_fpm7.* untuk domain belajarweb

Peringatan: jangan import ke DB belajarweb yang ada di home.pesanweb.my.id — itu DB konteks lain. Tujuan benar adalah DB belajarweb di MariaDB mesin 192.168.2.57. Versi Drupal sama (8.9.20) dan path sama, jadi dump+import valid; D8→D11 nanti butuh migrasi penuh, bukan sekadar dump.

entry.title: Cara Cek Container Aktif, vhost nginx & Arti /data/compose
entry.content:
Pertanyaan

Bagaimana cara melihat container yang aktif dan vhost nginx apa saja yang disajikannya? Apa isi ls /data/compose/ (10 12 14 16 19 23 30 32 33 34 drupal drupal-darinfs drupal8 drupal8a)? Apa arti tabel Volumes container drupal_web_server?

1. Cara cek container aktif & vhost-nya (home.pesanweb.my.id)

# Project compose mana yang aktif
ssh home.pesanweb.my.id "docker compose ls -a"
#  → drupal811  running(6)  /data/compose/34/docker-compose.yml
#  → root       running(1)  /root/portainer-compose.yaml

# Container + project + dir kerja masing-masing
docker ps --format '{{.Names}}\t{{.Label "com.docker.compose.project"}}\t{{.Label "com.docker.compose.project.working_dir"}}'

# Port mapping container nginx
docker port drupal_web_server
#  → 80/tcp -> 0.0.0.0:8086   81/tcp -> 0.0.0.0:8087

# Mount apa saja yang dipakai container (bind vs volume)
docker inspect drupal_web_server --format '{{json .Mounts}}'

# CARA PALING LENGKAP: dump seluruh config nginx yang benar-benar aktif
docker exec drupal_web_server nginx -T | grep -E 'listen|server_name|root |fastcgi_pass'

Di mesin swarm (192.168.2.57) namanya service, bukan compose: docker service ls, docker service ps <nama>, docker service inspect --format '{{json .Spec.TaskTemplate.ContainerSpec.Mounts}}' <nama>.

2. Hasil nginx -T — vhost aktif drupal_web_server

listenserver_namerootfastcgi_pass
80 (host 8086)localhost/var/www/html/drupal11/webdrupal_fpm:9000 (Drupal 11)
81 (host 8087)localhost/var/www/html2/drupal8/webdrupal_fpm7:9000 (Drupal 8)

Poin penting: nginx di sini bukan memilih berdasarkan domain — server_name localhost artinya catch-all. Yang membedakan domain adalah port (80 vs 81), dan pembeda domain di dalam Drupal 8 dilakukan oleh multisite lewat Host header (sites/web.pesanweb.my.id/, sites/belajarweb.pesanweb.my.id/). Jadi "vhost" sesungguhnya di mesin ini = 2 blok server berbasis port.

3. Penjelasan isi /data/compose/

Bukti: docker compose ls hanya menampilkan drupal811 (dari /data/compose/34/) + portainer. Sisanya bukan project aktif:

FolderStatusIsi / fungsi
34AKTIFProject drupal811 yang berjalan sekarang (drupal8-src, drupal11-src, nginx-conf, db-backup, drupal-data)
10 12 14 16 19 23 30 32 33inaktifSnapshot deployment lama (Des 2025), struktur serupa (drupal8-src, nginx-conf, db-backup…). Arsip/rollback — jangan dihapus asal
drupal-darinfsinaktifSnapshot paling lengkap (ada drupal8_data, drupal8_files, dump, images, import, private, snippets, template). Owner nobody:nogroup → hasil copy/rsync (kemungkinan dari NFS)
drupal, drupal8, drupal8a—Folder kosong

Pola penomoran = urutan deployment; tiap kali deploy baru dibuat folder nomor baru, folder lama ditinggalkan (bukan dihapus). Hanya folder yang ada di docker compose ls + docker ps label working_dir-nya yang benar-benar jalan.

4. Penjelasan tabel Volumes drupal_web_server

Host/volumePath di containerJenis & guna
/data/compose/34/nginx-conf/etc/nginx/conf.dbind — config vhost. Edit di host, reload nginx, langsung berlaku
/data/compose/34/drupal11-src/var/www/html/drupal11bind — kode Drupal 11
/data/compose/34/drupal8-src/var/www/html2/drupal8bind — kode Drupal 8 + semua folder multisite (web/sites/*)
drupal811_drupal11_files_volume/var/www/html/drupal11/web/sites/default/filesnamed volume — upload D11. Terpisah dari kode → aman saat ganti/update source
drupal811_drupal8_files_volume/var/www/html2/drupal8/web/sites/default/filesnamed volume — upload D8 situs default

Volume named lengkap di mesin ini: drupal811_drupal8_files_volume, drupal811_drupal11_files_volume, drupal811_drupal11_config_sync_volume (sync config D11), drupal811_drupal_db_data (data MariaDB).

Catatan penting: files untuk situs multisite (web.pesanweb.my.id, belajarweb.pesanweb.my.id) bukan di named volume — ikut bind mount drupal8-src di host: /data/compose/34/drupal8-src/web/sites/<domain>/files/. Hanya situs default yang files-nya pakai named volume.

5. Ringkasan ekosistem dua mesin

home.pesanweb.my.id192.168.2.57
Orkestratordocker compose (project drupal811, dir /data/compose/34)docker swarm (stack drupal-nfs, dir /data/compose/98)
Routing domainPort host 8086/8087 + multisite DrupalNginx Proxy Manager (tabel proxy_host) → 8087 → container :81
Situs D8web.pesanweb.my.id (DB drupal8)belajarweb.pesanweb.my.id (DB belajarweb)
